'''Courdon Dennard "Cory" Higgins''' (born June 14, 1989) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player who spent the majority of his career playing for [[PBC CSKA Moscow|CSKA Moscow]] and [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]] of the [[EuroLeague]].

==High school==
Higgins played high school basketball at [[Monte Vista High School (Danville, California)|Monte Vista High School]], in his hometown [[Danville, California]].

==College career==
Higgins played [[college basketball]] at the [[University of Colorado Boulder|University of Colorado]], with the [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado Buffaloes]], from 2007 to 2011. He is tied with [[Richard Roby]], with 2,001 career points, as the all-time leading scorer for the [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Buffaloes]], and he is sixth all-time in scoring [[Big 12 Conference]] history.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://blogs.charlotte.com/inside_the_nba/2011/12/bobcats-sign-cory-higgins.html |title=Bobcats sign Cory Higgins |work=Charlotte Observer.com |date=2011-12-25 |accessdate=2011-12-26 |archive-date=February 2, 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120202225322/http://blogs.charlotte.com/inside_the_nba/2011/12/bobcats-sign-cory-higgins.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Professional career==
After going undrafted in [[2011 NBA draft]], Higgins was selected with the seventh pick, in 2011 [[NBA D-League|D-League]] Draft, by the [[Erie BayHawks (2008–2017)|Erie BayHawks]]. He appeared in five games with the team, averaging 12.6 points.

Higgins was invited to the [[Denver Nuggets]] training camp, during the 2011 preseason, but on December 23, 2011, he was waived.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/nuggets/news/higgins_ruffin_12_23_2011.html |title=Denver Nuggets waive Higgins and Ruffin |work=NBA.com |date=2011-12-23 |accessdate=2011-12-26}}</ref>

On December 25, 2011, he was claimed off the waivers by the [[Charlotte Bobcats]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/bobcats/release_higgins_111225.html |title=Bobcats Claim Cory Higgins Off Waivers |work=NBA.com |date=2011-12-25 |accessdate=2011-12-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120108145713/http://www.nba.com/bobcats/release_higgins_111225.html |archive-date=2012-01-08 |url-status=dead }}</ref> He was waived by the Bobcats on December 9, 2012.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/bobcats/cats-sign-adrien-waive-higgins |title=Cats Sign Adrien, Waive Higgins. |website=[[NBA.com]] |access-date=2012-12-10 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121212002650/http://www.nba.com/bobcats/cats-sign-adrien-waive-higgins |archive-date=2012-12-12 |url-status=dead }}</ref> On January 16, 2013, Higgins was reacquired by the Erie BayHawks.<ref>[http://www.nba.com/dleague/erie/bayhawks_acquire_higgins_2013_01_16.html BayHawks Acquire Higgins.]</ref>

In October 2013, he signed a one-year deal with [[BC Triumph Lyubertsy|Triumph Lyubertsy]] of Russia.{{citation needed|date=November 2020}}

In June 2014, he signed a one-year deal with [[Royal Halı Gaziantep]] of Turkey.<ref>{{cite news|title=Cory Higgins signs with Gaziantep|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/123966/cory-higgins-signs-with-gaziantep.html|accessdate=June 24, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=June 24, 2014}}</ref>

On July 1, 2015, Higgins signed a one-year contract, with an option for a second year, with the Russian club [[PBC CSKA Moscow|CSKA Moscow]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Cory Higgins joined CSKA|url=http://www.cskabasket.com/news/?id=14442&lang=en|accessdate=July 1, 2015|work=cskabasket.com|date=July 1, 2015|archive-date=March 22, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180322143019/https://cskabasket.com/news/?id=14442&lang=en|url-status=dead}}</ref> Following a successful season, CSKA used its team option to keep Higgins in the club for yet another season.<ref>{{cite news|title=Cory Higgins stays for another season|url=http://www.cskabasket.com/news/?id=15224&lang=en|accessdate=17 June 2016|work=cskabasket.com|date=16 June 2016|archive-date=January 1, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170101205031/http://www.cskabasket.com/news/?id=15224&lang=en|url-status=dead}}</ref> On June 26, 2017, CSKA announced that they had renewed their contract with Higgins, for an additional two years.<ref>{{cite news|title=CSKA, Higgins sign on for two more years together|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/7weybvahfgn5bfxu|accessdate=June 26, 2017|work=Euroleague.net|date=June 26, 2017}}</ref>

On July 3, 2019, Higgins signed a three-year deal with the Spanish powerhouse [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Barcelona lands two-time champ Higgins |url=https://www.euroleague.net/news/i/9rvimymxu6xk8ory |accessdate=3 July 2019 |work=EuroLeague.net |date=3 July 2019}}</ref> During the 2020–2021 season, he averaged 13.1 points and 2.4 assists per game. On July 5, 2021, Higgins signed a three-year extension with the team.<ref>{{cite news |title=Barcelona extends Cory Higgins until 2024 |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/barcelona-extends-cory-higgins-until-2024/ |website=Sportando |access-date=July 5, 2021 |date=July 5, 2021 |last1=Skerletic |first1=Dario }}</ref> On August 1, 2023, Higgins was informed that his contract would be terminated under the new policy of the club for financial viability.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.cat/ca/basquet/primer-equip/noticies/3612462/rescissio-del-contracte-de-cory-higgins |title=Rescissió del contracte de Cory Higgins |access-date=August 1, 2023}}</ref>

==Coaching career==
On October 19, 2025, the [[Brooklyn Nets]] hired Higgins to serve as a scout.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Two-time EuroLeague champion Cory Higgins joins an NBA team|url=https://basketnews.com/news-233347-two-time-euroleague-champion-cory-higgins-joins-an-nba-team.html|access-date=October 26, 2025|website=basketnews.com|language=en}}</ref>

==Personal life==
His father, [[Rod Higgins]], is a former NBA player and the former president of the basketball operations for the [[Charlotte Bobcats]]. He majored in sociology. His godfather is former Chicago Bulls guard [[Michael Jordan]].<ref>[http://www.big12sports.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=10410&ATCLID=3636890 Colorado Student-Athlete Spotlight: Cory Higgins]</ref>
